intro: Iron Coral is an Alliance quest given by the gnome blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan in Tinker Town, Ironforge. Eager to test newly shared smithing methods on a custom suit of armor, Klockmort sends you to dive for rare searing coral along the coast of the Wetlands. Completing his request allows him to fuse gnomish ingenuity with dwarven craftsmanship.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I want to try Furen Longbeard's new techniques on my own piece of armor. And because you helped Furen and he helped me, you're welcome to the armor after I make it!
To finish the piece, I need a special coral, searing coral. It grows in only one place—along the coast south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Bring me enough searing coral and I'll get right to work on the armor. And hurry, friend. I'm so eager to get started it's making my toes twist!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello hello, friend! Do you have the searing coral? I can't wait to get to work!

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's the stuff! Well done! Now let me get this smelted and hammered so I can apply Furen's technique with my own and then we can see what happens!
Oh my, oh my! I just know the armor will be very very very tough!
